title: Figure 20: Non-Euclidean Cloaking Device in Two Dimensions
description: Four-panel figure labeled A to D. Panel A renders a curved plane touching a sphere with mapped grid lines; panels B and D show distorted coordinate grids in physical space with yellow light-ray paths and an eye-shaped hidden region; panel C shows a partly shaded wireframe sphere. The caption begins "Figure 20. Non-Euclidean Cloaking Device in Two Dimensions," in the section "Broadband Invisibility."
